description: MOP - Proyectos Prioritarios de Infraestructura vial de Obras Públicas is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Obras Públicas. Listado y avances de Proyectos Prioritarios del Ministerio de Obras Publicas. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Obras Públicas. Its tags are Avance de proyectos, proyectos. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2023-12-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
